verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left headline, steps in order 01-03 and a CTA, but the CTA is jammed at the bottom edge and the headline sits tight to the CTA. The fine print is tiny and runs right beside the button, and the bag is cropped by the circle and bottom. B has a good large headline, but the steps are scattered and out of sequence (01, 02 on top, 03 below), and the 01 and 03 text is tiny and hard to read. Its logo is shrunk to a speck on a clipped circle, the CTA floats far right, and the legal text is illegible.
